_source: Parent map of the canonical ACE Drive layout — ACE/<opp>/{opp.yaml, inputs/, runs/<run-id>/{run_state.yaml, decisions.yaml, <N>-<phase>/...}} — per agents/orchestrator-reference.md and ace-web apps/opps/opp_forker.py. Folder/file ids are synthetic; names and nesting are the real layout. 'other-opp' is a sibling opp in the same workspace root; 'TEMPLATES' stands for a shared template folder outside the ACE root.
